before: In this, the Savior himself was overturning an unlawful doctrine. For some people supposed that sinning souls are sent from heaven into a body for the sake of punishment, and that sometimes the soul remains pre-existing by itself apart from the body, while at other times it is intertwined with bodies on account of its own sins—so that a woman can conceive only when some soul sins. Destroying this error, Christ, when he was asked, said: "Neither this man sinned nor his parents, but this happened so that the works of God might be revealed" (John 3).
